title.narrative: Strengthening and enhancing capacities within Guyana’s Monitoring, Reporting, Verification System

description.narrative: The project aims to strengthen Monitoring, Reporting, Verification System (MRVS) to reinforce Guyana’s environmental management systems, bolster the country’s position in international environmental negotiations, support its development goals, and contribute to global climate action. This strategic investment is essential for ensuring national environmental stewardship and continued international collaboration. The project is demand driven as GGGI's government counterpart continue to request GGGI support in this area. The project also builds on previous GGGI projects and support for MRV

This project will seek to strengthen Guyana’s REDD+ MRVSthrough capacity building, an institutional roadmap, and enhanced interagency collaboration. This expansion will improve carbon finance access, supports sustainable forest management, and advances Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs) under the Paris Agreement, ensuring a resilient and data-driven approach to protecting Guyana’s forests and supporting global climate action.
